Ram Temple Donation Theft: 105 Incidents, 8 Accused in Custody, Chargesheet Due

A Special Investigation Team (SIT) from Uttar Pradesh informed the Supreme Court that it will file a chargesheet in two days regarding the theft of donations at the Ram Temple. The SIT's probe report indicated 105 instances of donation theft, with eight accused individuals currently in custody. The matter involves alleged theft of offerings at the temple.
